notes.title: Version 1.6
notes.content:
We continue to work on the game and the latest version (1.6) has received some new features. Here are some examples:

- The weapon selection is now visible on the main screen.

- Some enemies now drop items.

- There are some new corridors and paths in the world (the map expands).

- A new prototype of a combat drone is in the game.

- Many sound sources (e.g. from gun turrets) vary depending on distance.

notes.title: Version 1.15c
notes.content: In the latest version we have given the unarmed personnel a little more mobility. There are also some sound changes to the weapon and some doors. We were also able to improve the FPS value slightly. Please note that our game is still an early prototype.

notes.title: Version 1.15
notes.content:
This version of the game has some new features and gameplay elements:

- Reload and change weapons while hovering
- Opening inventory during flight
- Doubled card size
- New enemy behavior (we are still working on the AI)
- New functionalities such as variations of door systems with different keys, more variations of elevators, details in zero gravity
- Lots of new sounds
- etc.

notes.title: Version 1.13
notes.content:
This version includes several enhancements:

- Implementation of a new simple Done AI (will be extended soon)
- Extension of the door system with weight recording
- Operable elevator system
- Several corridors and textures added
- Etc.

notes.title: Version 1.12
notes.content:
- New elemental drone AI (will be expanded in further versions)
